accountHolder.title: Account holder name
accountHolder.description: The name on the bank account, as your bank shows it. Needed, with the account number or IBAN, before bank transfer is offered.

accountNumber.title: Account number
accountNumber.description: As payers in your country type it. Empty when payers use only your IBAN.

routingNumber.title: Routing number
routingNumber.description: Only where your country uses one (for example the ABA routing number in the United States).

sortCode.title: Sort code
sortCode.description: Only where your country uses one (for example in the United Kingdom and Ireland).

branchCode.title: Branch code
branchCode.description: Only where your country uses a branch or clearing code (for example a BSB, IFSC or transit number). Payers see it as Branch code; rename that label in Settings → Texts.

iban.title: IBAN
iban.description: Only where your bank gives one.

bic.title: SWIFT/BIC
bic.description: Your bank's SWIFT/BIC code, for payers in other countries.

requireDetails.title: Require bank details
requireDetails.description: Off: bank transfer is offered without the account holder name, once the instructions below or an account number or IBAN tell payers how to pay (for example when you send your details to the payer yourself).

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Shown under the bank details, for example what to write as the payment reference (plain text). With Require bank details off and no account number or IBAN, bank transfer is offered only with them.

proofUpload.title: Proof upload
proofUpload.description: Payers may upload a photo or PDF of their transfer to your storage.
